units.source_text: Nivolumab is given as 240 mg through a vein over 30 minutes OR 600 mg as an injection under the skin over 3–5 minutes, on Day 1 every 2 weeks. units.source_text: Nivolumab is given as 480 mg by intravenous (IV) infusion over 60 minutes OR 1200 mg by subcutaneous injection over 3–5 minutes, on Day 1 every 4 weeks. Allow extra time for assessment, preparation and observation. The team selects one formulation. A subcutaneous injection is given into the thigh or abdomen, alternating sites and avoiding damaged skin, scars or moles. IV and subcutaneous doses are not interchangeable milligram for milligram.
